body.markdown_zh:
在旧金山接受采访的内容，已经刊登成文章了。

杂志《Game Informer》6月号中

刊登了采访文章和照片！

买得到这本杂志的朋友，请一定要读读看哦！

Gamasutra也在4月公开了相关文章。

[http://www.gamasutra.com/php-bin/news_index.php?story=23052](http://www.gamasutra.com/php-bin/news_index.php?story=23052)

[http://www.gamasutra.com/view/feature/3979/the_art_of_balance_pokmons_.php](http://www.gamasutra.com/view/feature/3979/the_art_of_balance_pokmons_.php)

另外，从5月9日（周六）开始的美国地区大会，
在6月13日（周六）的大会上结束了！
六个地区大会似乎来了很多人，真是既感谢又感动。
详情请见大会官方网站

[http://www.pokemonvgc.com](http://www.pokemonvgc.com)。




<details class="gf-director-language"><summary>查看官方英文版</summary>

Here’s an interview article revealed when I had a

business trip to San Francisco.

On June issue of “Game Informer” magazine,

my interview article and picture are written up!

People who can pick up this magazine,

please do take a look!

Website “Gamasutra” also released an

interview article on this April.

[http://www.gamasutra.com/php-bin/news_index.php?story=23052](http://www.gamasutra.com/php-bin/news_index.php?story=23052)

[http://www.gamasutra.com/view/feature/3979/the_art_of_balance_pokmons_.php](http://www.gamasutra.com/view/feature/3979/the_art_of_balance_pokmons_.php)

And,

“Pokemon World Championships 2009.”

The championshios for United States Nationals

started on Saturday May 9th and ended on Saturday June 13th!

There are six regional championships were held in

United States and I heard there are tons of people

participated those events.

I deeply apprecite for all for coming.

Please check following

“Pokemon Video Game Championships” site for detail.

[http://www.pokemonvgc.com/](http://www.pokemonvgc.com/)

Ciao!


</details>
body.markdown_ja:
サンフランシスコで取材を受けたものが記事になりましたよ。

雑誌、Game Informer　6月号にて

インタビュー記事と写真が掲載されました！

購入出来る方、ぜひ読んでくださいね！

Gamasutraさんも4月に記事を公開しています。

[http://www.gamasutra.com/php-bin/news_index.php?story=23052](http://www.gamasutra.com/php-bin/news_index.php?story=23052)

[http://www.gamasutra.com/view/feature/3979/the_art_of_balance_pokmons_.php](http://www.gamasutra.com/view/feature/3979/the_art_of_balance_pokmons_.php)

また、５月９日（土）から始まったアメリカ地区大会が、

６月13日（土）の大会で終了しました！

６地区大会には多くの方々がいらっしゃって下さったようで感謝感激です。

詳しくは大会公式サイトにて
